text: H. Toda, Unstable 3-primary Homotopy Groups of Spheres, Econoinformatics 29 (2003), §5 “Old Table of 3-primary Groups”, printed pages 42–61 (PDF 49–68 of the scan Toda03-ocr.pdf). Copied from the page images and compared with the Mathpix recognition (wiki MATH page 882, file Toda03.pdf); page numbers in square brackets. Mathpix gets symbols wrong ($ ullet$ read as “-”, $\circ$ as “0”, $ eta_1^3(13)$ as $ eta_3^3(13)$, $12l$ as $12t$, the “•” of p. 49 as “∘”) and does not read the diagrams or the table of §5.6; wherever the two differ the image is right, and it is what is given here. Misprints of the original are kept and marked [sic]. In the scan the page with the text “(3) Let $\xi=\alpha_1(7)\circ\varphi(10)$ …” is printed twice (two printings numbered 58 and 59, PDF 65 and 66, with the same mathematics); it is given once, after PDF 65.

The diagrams are in Toda's notation: the columns are the odd spheres $S^n$, with $E^2$ between them; above a row the images under $H$ (the arrow $\nwarrow$ from the dot), below it the preimages under $P$ (the arrow $\nwarrow$ to the dot); where Toda leaves the arrows out, they are left out here too. The notation is in §5.2 below and on the page of the table.
The results of 3-primary $k$-th homotopy groups for $k\le45$ was given in Toda[37],[38] and announced for $k\le55$ by Maruyama and Mimura in 1998.

We begin to quote from Oka[22] the following list of 3-primary stable homotopy groups ${}_3\pi^S_k$ with generators for $k<62$ excluding the alpha type generators $\alpha_r$, $\alpha'_{3s}$, $\alpha''_{9t}$. For the notations of generators, we use those given in [22].
